name: Lantern Hollow Village
description: Explore Lantern Hollow inside New Bark Cave: a free healing lodge with a working PC, Coach Brin's repeatable L5/L15/L30 practice battles, and Mira's Lantern Garden with free berries and a three-lantern quest for a Lucky Egg. The free TM/HM and supply shop, marked cave exits, all six starters and EXP options remain.
notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.8 and use CONTINUE. Old cave saves load the fresh layout and move out of new buildings or residents; village NPC scripts refresh on Continue. Existing map/trainer/event IDs and save layout are preserved. Practice heals before/after, awards normal EXP, and allows losing without blackout. Garden quest progress persists; the Lucky Egg is once per save and waits if your bag is full. Lodge/hall saves require v1.8+; leave and save outside before reverting. Numbered states are exact-ROM-specific. Complete playthrough remains unverified.
